$comment: The company overlay: how an organization runs itself — its business functions, the policies that govern them, the teammates and roles that carry authority, the initiatives it sponsors and the accounts it holds with other organizations. Composes as core + company (+ data); it carries no plan DAG or delivery records, so it does not compose with engagement (both refine contextRecipes.default). Kinds are declared, not yet compiled (node null): records live in their fill-in artifacts until a source adapter compiles them.

kinds.title: Business Function
kinds.description: An organizational function of the company (finance, sales, delivery, people): the unit that owns roles, policies and budgets.

kinds.title: Policy
kinds.description: A company rule with an owner and an effective date: what may be committed, by whom, under which conditions. A change is a new policy that supersedes the old one.

kinds.title: Teammate
kinds.description: A person who works for or with the company (employee, contractor, advisor). Holds roles; affiliates to the owning organization.

kinds.title: Role
kinds.description: A named position with decision authority inside a business function, held by one or more teammates. Authority attaches to the role, not the person.

kinds.title: Initiative
kinds.description: A company-level effort with a sponsor, a desired change and measures; it may span projects and functions without joining the scope hierarchy.

kinds.title: Account
kinds.description: A commercial relationship the company holds with another organization (customer, partner, vendor): status, owner and terms.

edges.description: A role sits inside a business function.
A policy governs a function, role, initiative or account.
A teammate or role leads a business function, initiative or account.
An account is held with this organization register entry.

contextRecipes.$comment: Company task pack (#205): from any node, the documents it references, the policies that govern it, who leads and owns it, the function a role sits in, and the organization identity edges federation depends on. Replaces core's identity-only default; scripts/gen-task-pack.py walks each hop from the task node.
